items.name: theme
items.title: GoFive Theme
items.description: GoFive color system — neutral ramp, base orange brand, and per-product semantic palettes (Success/Warning/Danger/Info). Switch product palette at runtime via data-brand (empeo, calendio, venio, desk, shipx, salesbear, etaxgo, emconnect). Includes light and dark mode.

items.name: badge
items.title: Tag & Badge
items.description: Semantic status tags, count badges, avatar chips, and typing indicators with soft/solid/outline variants and pulse/spin/shimmer/pop animations.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: GoFive type scale — Display, H1–H3, Body Lg, Body, Small, and Caption with 400/500/600/700 weight overrides, rendered through a single variant-driven component.

items.name: fonts
items.title: GoFive Font
items.description: GoFive custom font family — Text (400), Medium (500), SemiBold (600), Bold (700)

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User avatars built on Radix with image fallback, five sizes, semantic status dots, solid/gradient fallback backgrounds, and an overlapping group with +N overflow.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A Radix-based checkbox supporting checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with primary-themed active styling and sm/md/lg sizes.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A Radix-based set of mutually exclusive options with primary-themed selection, hover, focus, and disabled states.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A Radix-based on/off toggle with a primary-themed track, sliding thumb, and sm/md/lg sizes.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A linear progress bar built on Radix Progress plus a circular ProgressRing, both with GoFive semantic colors; the bar offers three track sizes and the ring takes a custom diameter and center content.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A circular loading indicator plus a bouncing LoadingDots loader, both with size and semantic color props using the React 19 hoisted-keyframe pattern.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating input supporting controlled and uncontrolled use, hover preview, read-only display, and three sizes.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A popup that shows information on hover or focus, built on Radix Tooltip with provider, trigger, and content parts.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Primary-tinted status notifications with icon, title, description, optional action, close, and an auto-dismiss progress bar, driven by an imperative toast() store.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A composable modal dialog rendered over the page with header, body, and footer slots for confirm prompts, input-heavy forms, and multi-step wizards.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge of the screen, built on the Radix dialog primitive, with header, body, and footer slots for secondary panes and detail views.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet with a drag handle and drag-to-dismiss interaction built on Vaul, for mobile-style action menus and contextual options.

items.name: filter
items.title: Filter
items.description: Toggleable filter chips, a dropdown-driven filter bar, an advanced AND/OR condition builder, saved views, an applied-result summary, and a segmented control with a GoFive accent for active and has-value states.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: A styled search input with leading icon, command-K hint and clear button, a scope toggle and recent-search pills, a grouped results dropdown with highlighting, avatars, colored icon tiles and keyboard hints, loading-skeleton and no-results states, plus a controlled command palette with keyboard-navigable results.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment & Link
items.description: A file dropzone, uploaded-file rows with type icon, size, upload progress, and remove, plus rich link preview cards for upload UIs.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A self-contained month calendar with single-date and range selection, today highlighting, and out-of-month muted days, built on plain JS dates.

items.name: scheduler
items.title: Scheduler
items.description: An event calendar with Month, Week, and Day/Agenda views, a segmented view switcher, Today navigation, and color-coded events, built on plain JS dates with no external date library.

items.name: datetime-picker
items.title: DateTime Picker
items.description: Popover-based date, time, and combined date-time pickers built on the GoFive Calendar, with controlled state and no external date library.

items.name: picker
items.title: Picker
items.description: Composable color, emoji, and icon pickers that each pair a trigger with a Radix Popover panel — the color picker adds hue/alpha sliders, a hex field and recent swatches, the emoji picker adds category tabs and a name/shortcode/unicode preview, and the icon picker adds outline/solid/duotone style variants — with raw grids exported for inline use.

items.name: media-picker
items.title: Media Picker
items.description: A file & media picker with Library, Upload, From URL, and Unsplash tabs — a searchable thumbnail grid with single-select check, a drag-and-drop upload zone, a URL field with live preview, and a Cancel / Insert footer, available as a popover or a standalone panel.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal application menu bar with dropdown menus, items, shortcuts, separators, checkbox and radio items, and nested submenus.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu surfaced at the pointer with items, shortcuts, separators, checkbox and radio items, and nested submenus for contextual actions.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A horizontal and vertical step indicator with done, active, and upcoming states, numbered circles, completion checks, connectors, and optional per-step descriptions.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder with shimmer or pulse animation and a circle option, using the React 19 hoisted-keyframe pattern.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A centered empty, error, or zero-data state with a tinted illustration tile, title, description, and action slot, in five semantic tones.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline info bar / banner with a left accent border, status icon, optional dismiss button, and info, success, warn, and danger variants.

items.name: validation
items.title: Validation
items.description: Inline field validation messages in error, warn, success, and info states, plus a pass/fail rule checklist for password and form requirements.

items.name: scale
items.title: Scale
items.description: Feedback survey scales — an NPS 0–10 numeric selector and a CSAT emoji selector, both controllable and uncontrolled.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A GoFive text field with default, error, success, disabled, and read-only states, xs–lg sizes, filled and underline variants, leading/trailing icons, prefix/suffix affixes, a clear button, plus PasswordInput reveal toggle and NumberInput stepper.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field with focus, error, and success states, an optional character counter, and auto-resize.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code input rendered as individual digit cells with full keyboard, paste, and autofill support, configurable length, and an optional masked display.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range slider built on Radix with a GoFive primary fill, single or two-thumb selection, steps, vertical orientation, and an optional value label.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: An inline tab-style switch with a white active segment, sm/md/lg sizes, optional icons, and a full-width option, driven by controlled or uncontrolled state.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A popover-based single Select and MultiSelect with searchable combobox filtering, grouped and rich rows, status dots, disabled options, an empty state, and a multi-select chips trigger with select-all and an apply footer.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A free-form tag entry field with removable chips, Enter/comma to add, Backspace to remove, max-tags and duplicate guards.

items.name: tree-select
items.title: Tree Select
items.description: A hierarchical TreeSelect for single category picks with a breadcrumb trigger, plus a TreeMultiSelect with cascading parent/child checkboxes, indeterminate state, chips, and an apply footer.

items.name: person-picker
items.title: Person Picker
items.description: Single and multi person pickers with avatars, presence dots, grouped search, removable assignee chips, an invite-by-email fallback, and a ReviewerStack with stacked avatars and per-person review status.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Navigation tabs in four looks — underline, soft pill, segmented, and vertical — with optional count badges, driven by controlled or uncontrolled state.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: A top application bar composed of brand, primary nav items with an active state, a flexible spacer, trailing icon actions, and an avatar slot.

items.name: bottom-nav
items.title: Bottom Navigation
items.description: A mobile bottom navigation bar whose active item tints its label and shows a soft primary pill behind the icon.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A vertical navigation panel with brand, section labels, items with icons and count badges, and nested sub-items, plus a collapsed icon-only rail variant.

items.name: all
items.title: GoFive — All Components
items.description: Installs every GoFive component, theme, and font in one command via npx shadcn add @gofive/all.
